title: Enterprise Cloud Browser Fleet & CDP Pool Selection: Firecracker CoW Snapshot MicroVMs vs. Shared BrowserContexts & Monolithic Containers

workload_basis.spa_complexity: Heavy Enterprise React/Canvas ERP & Multi-Tab Research

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Monolithic Cold Chromium per Container (Default 64MB /dev/shm)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern (64MB /dev/shm crashes tabs; zombie renderers leak 1.8GB/session)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Shared Chromium Process with 25 Playwright BrowserContexts
tiers.recommended_scenario: Internal single-tenant test runners (1 runaway tab crashes 24 neighbor sessions)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Tuned K8s Pod Pool (2GB /dev/shm + dumb-init + Warm Standby Replicas)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard Kubernetes enterprise browser pool without bare-metal KVM access

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Firecracker / Cloud Hypervisor CoW Memory-Snapshot Browser Pool + CDP Proxy + Idle Pause
tiers.recommended_scenario: Multi-tenant Enterprise Browser Agents (140ms CoW restore, 99.95% reliability, hardware VM isolation)
